homeAbout.title: About Our Company
homeAbout.subtitle: Trusted transport partner of Mewar since 2009
homeAbout.founderName: Mr. Narendra Kumar Purbiya Naresh Chaudhary
homeAbout.p1: Shree Mateshwari Enterprises has been proudly serving the people of Mewar region for over 15 years. Founded by Mr. Narendra Kumar Purbiya Naresh Chaudhary, our mission is simple — provide safe, affordable, and reliable bus services to every corner of Rajasthan's heartland.
homeAbout.p2: We operate multiple daily routes connecting Fatehnagar, Barisadri, Salumbar, Bhilwara, Bhinder, Aawari Mata Ji, Udaipur, Mangalwar, Kanore and surrounding areas. Our buses run on nominal prices so that every commuter — student, farmer, or professional — can travel with dignity.
